title: Where Did Your Model Learn That? Label-free Influence for Self-supervised Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on developing a method called Influence-SSL to analyze data influence in self-supervised learning models, with experiments on duplicate detection, outlier identification, and racial fairness using image datasets.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was not part of its investigation.
